meta.product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)
meta.status: PLANNED next-phase roadmap draft, 2026-10-11. Nothing here is shipped, deployed, accredited, or union-endorsed. Learning efficacy is unestablished.
meta.pedagogy: Flipped loop, 4 phases per module: prepare (at home) -> analyze -> practice (in sim) -> verify (virtual job site).
meta.builds_on: 333 walkable interior sites, 1,665 station scripts, ACP adaptive stack (AI-ZPD dial, 5-rung hint engine, skill graph, parity safeguards), licensing registry 51 x 6 (3 cosmetology states sourced: IL 1,500 h, FL 1,200 h, ID 1,600 h), Chargebee in test mode.

courses.title: Residential Electrical Foundations (NEC 2023)

modules.title: Ohm's Law, Circuits and Meter Use

flipped.prepare: Read on series vs parallel circuits and watch a CAT III multimeter walkthrough; 10-question check on V=IR and P=VI.
flipped.analyze: Given a 3-room panel schedule, compute branch loads and flag any 15 A circuit above 80% continuous load.
flipped.practice: Sim bench: measure voltage, continuity and resistance on a live-dead-live test sequence without skipping the proving step.
flipped.verify: Virtual job site: troubleshoot a dead bedroom receptacle traced to an open neutral on a backstabbed device.

flipped.prepare: Short reading on equipment grounding conductor vs grounded conductor, main bonding jumper and grounding electrode system.
flipped.analyze: Spot-the-fault on 6 panel photos: neutrals and grounds bonded in a subpanel, missing water-pipe bond, undersized GEC.
flipped.practice: Sim: land EGCs, separate neutral and ground bars in a subpanel, install bonding jumper at the water heater.
flipped.verify: Job-site inspection walk with an inspector NPC; student must cite the article for each correction.

flipped.prepare: Ampacity table primer: 14 AWG Cu = 15 A, 12 AWG = 20 A, 10 AWG = 30 A (small-conductor rule 240.4(D)).
flipped.analyze: Size conductors and OCPD for a 30 A dryer and 50 A range; compute voltage drop on a 120 ft run and keep it under 3%.
flipped.practice: Sim rough-in: drill studs, staple NM cable within 12 in. of boxes, box fill calculation per 314.16.
flipped.verify: Finish trim-out of a kitchen with 20 A small-appliance circuits and GFCI/AFCI where required; pass the sim inspection.

flipped.prepare: Watch a module on line vs load terminals and 3-way/4-way switching.
flipped.analyze: Read 4 switch-loop diagrams and pick which one creates a switched neutral (code violation).
flipped.practice: Sim: wire a 3-way hallway circuit and a GFCI protecting downstream bathroom receptacles.
flipped.verify: Customer call: tripping AFCI on a bedroom circuit; isolate a shared neutral and report findings to the homeowner NPC.

flipped.prepare: Read OSHA 1910.147 LOTO steps and NFPA 70E arc-flash boundary basics.
flipped.analyze: Order 6 shuffled LOTO steps and identify the missing verification of zero energy.
flipped.practice: Sim: apply personal lock and tag on a 200 A disconnect, test-before-touch with a proven meter.
flipped.verify: Sam runs a surprise energized-equipment scenario; any skipped step ends the attempt and triggers a debrief.

courses.licensure_note: Planned prep only; electrical licensing is state/local and typically needs supervised OJT hours plus an exam. No state has accepted these hours and the registry has no electrical state sourced yet.

courses.title: Plumbing Systems: DWV, Supply and Fixtures

flipped.prepare: Reading on traps, vents and fall: 1/4 in. per ft for drains 3 in. and smaller; why trap seals siphon.
flipped.analyze: Isometric review: find an S-trap, an unvented island sink and a horizontal wet vent sized too small.
flipped.practice: Sim: lay out a bathroom group DWV with correct fittings (long-sweep 90s, sanitary tees on vertical only).
flipped.verify: Virtual job site: water test the stack to 10 ft head and locate a leaking joint.

flipped.prepare: Watch a primer on PEX, copper Type L/M and CPVC, and fixture units.
flipped.analyze: Compute fixture units for a 2-bath house and size the main and branches from a provided table.
flipped.practice: Sim: sweat a copper joint (clean, flux, heat fitting, feed solder) and crimp PEX with a go/no-go gauge.
flipped.verify: Pressure-test the rough-in at the required test pressure and hold time; document results on a test sheet.

flipped.prepare: Read install sheets for a toilet, lav faucet and tub/shower valve with anti-scald limit stop.
flipped.analyze: Diagnose 5 callback photos: rocking toilet, wax ring leak, reversed hot/cold, missing escutcheon, no air gap.
flipped.practice: Sim: set a toilet on a flange, install a lav with P-trap and set the shower valve limit stop to 120 F.
flipped.verify: Customer walkthrough with homeowner NPC; explain the work and leave the site clean.

flipped.prepare: Reading on T&P relief valves, expansion tanks, and cross-connection control.
flipped.analyze: Review 4 water-heater installs and flag a capped T&P discharge and a missing expansion tank on a closed system.
flipped.practice: Sim: replace a 50 gal gas water heater including venting check, sediment trap and gas leak test.
flipped.verify: Job site: commercial kitchen with a cross-connection; specify the correct backflow assembly type.

courses.licensure_note: Planned prep only; plumbing licensure is state/local (IPC or UPC jurisdictions) with apprenticeship hours and exams. No jurisdiction sourced or accepting these hours.

courses.title: HVAC/R Service Technician

flipped.prepare: Watch the 4-component cycle (compressor, condenser, metering device, evaporator) with a P-H diagram overlay.
flipped.analyze: Given gauge readings, determine saturation temps from a PT chart for R-410A and R-454B.
flipped.practice: Sim: connect manifold gauges and read suction/liquid pressures on a running split system.
flipped.verify: Service call: system blowing warm; identify a dirty condenser coil from high head pressure.

flipped.prepare: Read on target superheat for fixed orifice and target subcooling for TXV systems.
flipped.analyze: Classify 6 reading sets as undercharge, overcharge, restriction or low airflow.
flipped.practice: Sim: weigh in charge to subcooling target with a digital scale; adaptive dial varies outdoor temp.
flipped.verify: Job site: 3-ton TXV system with 2 F subcooling; find and repair the leak before recharging.

flipped.prepare: Study guide covering Core, Type I, II and III content: venting prohibition, recovery and leak-repair rules.
flipped.analyze: Practice items mirroring the Core section; hint engine explains each miss.
flipped.practice: Sim: recover refrigerant into a DOT cylinder without exceeding 80% fill by weight.
flipped.verify: Timed mock exam; results logged as practice only.

flipped.prepare: Primer on Manual J load and Manual D duct design concepts, static pressure and CFM per ton.
flipped.analyze: Read a total external static measurement and judge whether the blower can deliver 400 CFM/ton.
flipped.practice: Sim: measure static, swap a restrictive filter, adjust blower tap and re-measure.
flipped.verify: Job site: comfort complaint in a 2-story home; balance dampers and document before/after temps.

flipped.prepare: Watch: contactors, run capacitors, 24 V control wiring (R, C, Y, G, W).
flipped.analyze: Ladder diagram exercise: trace why the condenser fan runs but the compressor hums and trips.
flipped.practice: Sim: test a dual run capacitor in microfarads after safely discharging it, replace if out of tolerance.
flipped.verify: Sam scenario: arc-flash and LOTO before opening the disconnect; any skip fails the visit.

courses.licensure_note: EPA Section 608 certification is federally required to buy/handle refrigerant and must be earned from an EPA-approved certifying organization; this course is planned prep only and certifies nothing.

courses.title: Structural Welding: SMAW and GMAW Plate

flipped.prepare: Read on fume control, shade numbers (10-13 for SMAW), hot-work permits and fire watch.
flipped.analyze: Spot 6 hazards in a booth photo: cylinders unchained, wet gloves, missing screen, cracked lens.
flipped.practice: Sim: set amperage for 1/8 in. E7018 (about 90-140 A), check ground clamp and stinger insulation.
flipped.verify: Sam audits the booth before Joyce allows the first arc.

flipped.prepare: Watch Joyce demo arc length, travel speed and 5-15 degree drag angle with E7018.
flipped.analyze: Grade 6 bead photos for undercut, porosity, slag inclusions and cold lap.
flipped.practice: Haptic sim: run 2F fillets; dial adjusts travel-speed tolerance per AI-ZPD.
flipped.verify: Visual inspection to a workmanship checklist modeled on AWS D1.1 Table 8.1 criteria.

flipped.prepare: Read on joint prep: 22.5 degree bevel, 1/4 in. root opening, backing strip.
flipped.analyze: Review a WPS and identify essential variables (process, filler, position, preheat).
flipped.practice: Sim: root, hot pass, fill and cap on 3/8 in. plate in 3G with weave control.
flipped.verify: Virtual bend test: sim coupons are cut and bent; discontinuities over 1/8 in. fail.

flipped.prepare: Watch: wire feed speed vs voltage, 75/25 Ar/CO2 vs 90/10 for spray.
flipped.analyze: Match 4 sound/spatter profiles to their transfer mode and fix the settings.
flipped.practice: Sim: run 1F and 2F fillets in spray, 3F in short-circuit.
flipped.verify: Job site: steel stair stringer repair; Joyce reviews against the posted WPS.

flipped.prepare: Primer on AWS A2.4 symbols: arrow vs other side, field weld flag, all-around.
flipped.analyze: Read 8 symbols from a structural drawing and state size, type and side.
flipped.practice: Sim: tack and fit a T-joint within 1/16 in. tolerance using a square and clamps.
flipped.verify: Fabricate a bracket from print; measured against drawing tolerances.

courses.robotics_link: Robotic GMAW welding cell (6-axis arm with torch, positioner and fume extraction), bridging to TCA-310.
courses.licensure_note: Welder certification (e.g. AWS D1.1 performance qualification) is done by an accredited test facility on real coupons; sim results are practice only and are not a certification.

courses.title: Residential Framing and Finish Carpentry

flipped.prepare: Watch: tape reading to 1/16 in., speed square, chalk line, 3-4-5 squaring method.
flipped.analyze: Check a slab layout using diagonals and find the 1/2 in. out-of-square corner.
flipped.practice: Sim: lay out a wall plate at 16 in. on center with king, jack and cripple locations.
flipped.verify: Job site: snap wall lines on a slab from the foundation plan.

flipped.prepare: Read IRC basics on header sizing, top plate splices and 2x6 exterior walls.
flipped.analyze: Pick a header size for a 6 ft opening from a span table given load conditions.
flipped.practice: Sim: frame and raise a 12 ft wall with a door and window opening, plumb and brace.
flipped.verify: Inspection NPC checks stud spacing, nailing schedule and opening sizes.

flipped.prepare: Read IRC stair limits: max riser 7-3/4 in., min tread 10 in., headroom 6 ft 8 in.
flipped.analyze: Compute riser count and size for a 108 in. total rise; check the tread run fits.
flipped.practice: Sim: lay out a stringer with a framing square and stair gauges, cut and test-fit.
flipped.verify: Build a 3-stringer stair on site; tolerance check of 3/8 in. max riser variation.

flipped.prepare: Watch: common rafter, birdsmouth, ridge board vs ridge beam, roof pitch.
flipped.analyze: Calculate common rafter length for a 24 ft span at 6/12 pitch.
flipped.practice: Sim: cut a pattern rafter and set rafters with fall protection anchors in place.
flipped.verify: Sam audits fall protection (guardrail or PFAS at 6 ft in construction) before sign-off.

flipped.prepare: Read on miter vs cope joints, reveals and hanging prehung doors.
flipped.analyze: Diagnose why a door binds at the head jamb and rubs at the latch side.
flipped.practice: Sim: hang a prehung door, case it, cope inside base corners.
flipped.verify: Homeowner punch-list walk; fix 5 finish defects.

courses.licensure_note: Most states do not license carpenters individually (contractor licensing varies); OSHA 10/30 cards come only from OSHA-authorized trainers. Nothing here is accredited.

courses.title: Heavy Equipment Operation and Site Survey (Drone and Rover)

flipped.prepare: Read on walkaround inspection, three-point contact, swing radius barricades and 811 call-before-you-dig.
flipped.analyze: Find 6 defects on an excavator walkaround photo set: hydraulic leak, cracked bucket tooth, missing seat belt.
flipped.practice: Sim: complete a pre-op checklist on a 20-ton excavator and a skid steer.
flipped.verify: Sam: site start-up meeting where the student briefs utilities locates and exclusion zones.

flipped.prepare: Read OSHA 1926 Subpart P: protective systems at 5 ft and deeper, soil types A/B/C, spoil 2 ft from edge.
flipped.analyze: Choose a sloping ratio or trench box for a 7 ft trench in Type C soil (1.5:1).
flipped.practice: Sim: dig a 60 ft trench to grade with ISO controls; dial adjusts depth tolerance.
flipped.verify: Job site: trench for a sewer lateral; competent-person NPC inspects before entry.

flipped.prepare: Watch: grade stakes, cut/fill, 2D vs 3D machine control with a site design model.
flipped.analyze: Read a cut/fill sheet and compute volumes for a 50 x 80 ft pad.
flipped.practice: Sim: dozer finish-grade to plus or minus 0.1 ft using 3D guidance.
flipped.verify: Rover check-shots across the pad; out-of-tolerance cells must be reworked.

flipped.prepare: Study FAA Part 107 topics: airspace classes, LAANC, VLOS, 400 ft AGL, weather minimums.
flipped.analyze: Plan a grid mission: 75% front / 65% side overlap, GSD target, ground control point placement.
flipped.practice: Sim: fly the mission, set 5 GCPs, process an orthomosaic and surface model.
flipped.verify: Compare stockpile volume from drone vs rover; explain differences over 3%.

flipped.prepare: Read on RTK base/rover, fixed vs float solutions and localization to site control.
flipped.analyze: Reject 3 shots taken in float solution from a data log.
flipped.practice: Sim: stake out 12 building corners from a design file with an autonomous survey rover.
flipped.verify: As-built report checked against plans by the superintendent NPC.

courses.robotics_link: Autonomous site-survey drone and RTK GNSS rover; 3D machine-control excavator/dozer.
courses.licensure_note: Commercial drone flight requires an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate from an FAA knowledge test; crane work may require NCCCO. This course is planned prep only and confers neither.

courses.title: Hair Design: Cutting and Color Theory

flipped.prepare: Read on EPA-registered disinfectants, contact time, and the client intake card.
flipped.analyze: Review 5 consultation transcripts and flag missed contraindications (scalp abrasions, prior henna).
flipped.practice: Sim: disinfect implements and run a consultation with a client NPC asking for a dramatic change.
flipped.verify: State-board-style sanitation check by Tessa.

flipped.prepare: Watch Tessa demo 4-section parting, 0/45/90/180 degree elevation and stationary vs traveling guides.
flipped.analyze: Match 6 finished shapes to the elevation and guide used.
flipped.practice: Sim mannequin: one-length bob at 0 degrees and a uniform layer at 90 degrees.
flipped.verify: Client booking: graduated bob; Tessa scores balance and weight line.

flipped.prepare: Read the level system 1-10, underlying pigment, and developer volumes (10, 20, 30, 40).
flipped.analyze: Formulate for a client at level 5 wanting level 7 neutral; identify exposed orange-gold to neutralize.
flipped.practice: Sim: mix, apply a root retouch with 1/2 in. partings, process and rinse.
flipped.verify: Client returns with banding; correct it and document the formula card.

flipped.prepare: Watch on foil placement, bond builders, and strand and patch testing (24-48 h patch test per manufacturer).
flipped.analyze: Decide whether a box-dyed client can safely be lifted in one session.
flipped.practice: Sim: partial highlight with lightener, then tone with a demi-permanent.
flipped.verify: Client consultation where Tessa expects the student to decline or stage the service if unsafe.

flipped.prepare: Read on alkaline waves and thio vs hydroxide relaxers; never overlap incompatible chemicals.
flipped.analyze: Test-curl results: decide when to rinse and neutralize.
flipped.practice: Sim: perm wrap with end papers on a 9-block pattern.
flipped.verify: State-board-style practical walkthrough timed against a mock exam clock.

courses.licensure_note: Cosmetology hour minimums sourced only for IL (1,500), FL (1,200), ID (1,600); no state board has approved these hours and other states are unsourced.

courses.title: Nail Technology: Natural Nail to Enhancements

modules.title: Nail Anatomy, Disorders and Infection Control

flipped.prepare: Read on nail plate, matrix, eponychium vs cuticle; when to refer (paronychia, onycholysis with infection).
flipped.analyze: Sort 10 photos into service-OK vs refer-to-physician.
flipped.practice: Sim: clean and disinfect a pedicure spa per manufacturer and log it.
flipped.verify: Gemma inspects the station; single-use items must be discarded.

flipped.prepare: Watch Gemma demo filing shapes (square, squoval, oval, almond) and cuticle care.
flipped.analyze: Spot over-filing and cuticle nipping errors in 5 videos.
flipped.practice: Sim: full manicure with polish, clean cuticle line, no flooding.
flipped.verify: Client NPC with diabetes on a pedicure booking; student must modify (no cutting, no sharp implements on calluses).

flipped.prepare: Read on bit types, RPM ranges and why to avoid heat spikes; LED vs UV curing.
flipped.analyze: Diagnose lifting and wrinkling: thick coats, under-curing, cuticle contact.
flipped.practice: Sim: gel prep, thin coats, cure per lamp spec, and safe soak-off.
flipped.verify: Client returns in 2 weeks; evaluate wear and adjust technique.

flipped.prepare: Read on liquid-to-powder ratio, apex placement and the MMA liquid ban in many states.
flipped.analyze: Identify a structure lacking apex and a stress area at risk of cracking.
flipped.practice: Sim: sculpt on forms with a smile line; adaptive dial tightens symmetry tolerance.
flipped.verify: Board-style practical: one sculptured nail, timed, with sanitation scored.

courses.licensure_note: Nail technician hour requirements are set by each state board and are not yet sourced in the registry; no board has approved this course.

courses.title: Esthetics: Skin Analysis and Facial Treatments

flipped.prepare: Read on epidermis layers, Fitzpatrick types I-VI and Glogau photoaging scale.
flipped.analyze: Analyze 6 client images under woods lamp simulation; record skin type and conditions.
flipped.practice: Sim: full skin analysis with magnifying lamp and consultation form.
flipped.verify: Iris reviews the treatment plan for accuracy and scope.

flipped.prepare: Read on contraindications: isotretinoin use, active infection, recent laser, pregnancy for certain actives.
flipped.analyze: Triage 8 intake forms into proceed, modify, or refer.
flipped.practice: Sim: client discloses retinoid use; adjust the service and document.
flipped.verify: Iris scenario where the client requests a medical procedure; student must decline within scope.

flipped.prepare: Watch Iris demo cleanse, exfoliate, steam, extract, massage, mask, protect.
flipped.analyze: Order a scrambled protocol and justify each step's purpose.
flipped.practice: Sim: full facial with Swedish-style effleurage and petrissage on a client avatar.
flipped.verify: Client NPC feedback and post-care instructions including SPF.

flipped.prepare: Read on comedone types and superficial peels (low-percent glycolic, lactic) within esthetician scope.
flipped.analyze: Decide which lesions are safe to extract vs refer (cystic acne).
flipped.practice: Sim: gloved extractions with proper angle and pressure; apply and neutralize a superficial peel on timing.
flipped.verify: Client returns with mild erythema; handle the follow-up and record it.

flipped.prepare: Watch hard vs soft wax technique and brow mapping.
flipped.analyze: Identify lifting risk factors in 5 intake forms.
flipped.practice: Sim: brow wax with correct direction of pull and skin support.
flipped.verify: Board-style practical with sanitation scoring.

courses.licensure_note: Esthetics hour minimums vary by state and are not yet sourced in the registry; no board has approved this course.

courses.title: Industrial Robot Arm Operator

flipped.prepare: Read on ANSI/RIA R15.06 and ISO 10218 concepts: safeguarded space, E-stop, 3-position enabling device, T1 reduced speed (250 mm/s).
flipped.analyze: Spot 5 safeguarding failures in a cell layout: bypassed interlock, light curtain gap, no lockout point.
flipped.practice: Sim: enter a cell under LOTO and verify zero energy including pneumatics.
flipped.verify: Sam audits the student's cell entry; any bypass ends the attempt.

flipped.prepare: Watch: joint, world, user and tool frames; jog increments.
flipped.analyze: Predict arm motion for a jog command in each frame from a still image.
flipped.practice: Sim: jog a 6-axis arm in T1 to touch 4 fixture points without collision.
flipped.verify: Timed pick-and-place setup with a part fixture.

flipped.prepare: Read on tool center point calibration via 4-point method and linear vs joint moves.
flipped.analyze: Debug a program where a joint move clips the fixture; choose where linear moves are needed.
flipped.practice: Sim: teach a palletizing program with approach, pick, retract points.
flipped.verify: Run the program at production speed in auto with guarding closed; cycle time logged.

flipped.prepare: Joyce reviews how GMAW variables map to robot weld schedules.
flipped.analyze: Read a weld-schedule table and fix a travel speed causing undercut.
flipped.practice: Sim: touch-sense a joint and run a fillet with seam tracking.
flipped.verify: Production lot of 10 brackets inspected visually by Joyce.

flipped.prepare: Read on common faults: collision detection, overtravel, encoder battery low.
flipped.analyze: Order recovery steps for a collision fault without losing position data.
flipped.practice: Sim: recover from a fault, replace a worn torch tip, back up the controller.
flipped.verify: Shift-handoff report to supervisor NPC.

courses.robotics_link: 6-axis industrial arm cell (palletizing and robotic GMAW variants).
courses.licensure_note: No state license exists for robot operators; vendor certificates (e.g. arm manufacturer training) are issued by vendors, not by this course. Nothing here is accredited.

courses.title: Collaborative Robot (Cobot) Safety and Deployment

flipped.prepare: Read the 4 modes: safety-rated monitored stop, hand guiding, speed and separation monitoring, power and force limiting.
flipped.analyze: Assign the right mode to 6 described tasks.
flipped.practice: Sim: configure speed and separation monitoring zones with an area scanner.
flipped.verify: Walk-in test with a worker avatar; arm must slow and stop at the configured distances.

flipped.prepare: Read on task-based risk assessment and hazard identification (pinch points, sharp tooling).
flipped.analyze: Complete a risk assessment for a cobot screwdriving station; rate severity and exposure.
flipped.practice: Sim: add mitigations (padding, reduced speed, tool change) and re-score.
flipped.verify: Sam reviews the residual risk; unmitigated high risks block go-live.

flipped.prepare: Watch on body-region contact limits and transient vs quasi-static contact.
flipped.analyze: Interpret a force-measurement report and decide pass/fail per body region.
flipped.practice: Sim: tune payload, speed and force limits for a machine-tending task.
flipped.verify: Run a validated cycle with a co-worker avatar sharing the workspace.

flipped.prepare: Read on safety checksums, password-protected safety config and revalidation after changes.
flipped.analyze: Find why a config change after commissioning invalidated the risk assessment.
flipped.practice: Sim: document commissioning, sign-off sheet and operator training record.
flipped.verify: Audit by Sam and Dana: operator briefing delivered to a mixed crew.

courses.robotics_link: Cobot machine-tending and screwdriving stations with area scanners.
courses.licensure_note: No license applies; content references public standards concepts only. Not accredited, not endorsed by any standards body.

courses.title: Crew Leadership and Emotional Intelligence on the Job

flipped.prepare: Chris's EI reading on recognizing stress signals and naming emotions before acting.
flipped.analyze: Review a tense job-site transcript and mark where the foreman escalated.
flipped.practice: Sim role-play: a late concrete truck and an angry GC; student practices pause-and-reframe.
flipped.verify: Dana debrief scored on a behavior rubric, not personality.

flipped.prepare: Watch Sam and Dana run a 10-minute toolbox talk.
flipped.analyze: Rewrite a vague assignment into who/what/when/standard.
flipped.practice: Sim: deliver a toolbox talk on ladder safety to a crew of avatars with questions.
flipped.verify: Crew avatars execute the task; errors traced to unclear instructions count against the leader.

flipped.prepare: Read on the situation-behavior-impact feedback model.
flipped.analyze: Classify 6 feedback statements as specific or vague, blaming or behavioral.
flipped.practice: Sim: resolve a conflict between a journeyworker and an apprentice over task assignments.
flipped.verify: Follow-up session days later in sim; check if agreements held.

flipped.prepare: Chris reading on psychological safety and stop-work authority.
flipped.analyze: Review an incident report where an apprentice did not speak up; identify cultural causes.
flipped.practice: Sim: coach an apprentice through a first-time task using demonstrate-observe-correct.
flipped.verify: Dana evaluates the apprentice avatar's progress across 3 sessions.

courses.licensure_note: No license or credential; any union or employer recognition would need a separate agreement and none exists today.

teacher_kit.name: Lesson Planner
teacher_kit.what: Builds a week of flipped lessons from a course module: assigns prepare content, picks analyze cases, schedules sim practice and a verify job site; exports to a printable plan.

teacher_kit.name: Cohort Dashboard
teacher_kit.what: Per-student view of skill-graph mastery, AI-ZPD dial level, hint rungs used, and time-on-task, with flags for students stalled more than 3 sessions.

teacher_kit.name: Rubric Builder
teacher_kit.what: Generates observable-behavior rubrics per trade (e.g. weld bead visual criteria, color formulation accuracy) that the teacher edits and locks before grading.

teacher_kit.name: Sim Assignment Composer
teacher_kit.what: Assigns specific interior sites and station scripts from the 333 built sites, sets dial bounds and hint caps, and sets due dates.

teacher_kit.name: Parity Report
teacher_kit.what: Applies ACP parity safeguards to show whether outcomes, hint access and dial ceilings differ across student groups; flags gaps for teacher review, not automatic action.

teacher_kit.name: Safety Gate Console
teacher_kit.what: Lets the teacher require a passed safety module (LOTO, hot work, cell entry) before a student unlocks hazardous sim stations; logs every override.

teacher_kit.name: Licensure Hours Ledger (planned)
teacher_kit.what: Tracks sim and theory hours by trade against registry entries; marks every row as unverified by any board and only shows sourced state minimums (IL, FL, ID cosmetology).

teacher_kit.name: Trade Demo Library
teacher_kit.what: Mentor-recorded demonstrations (Joyce on 3G root pass, Tessa on sectioning, Gemma on apex placement, Iris on extractions) teachers can embed in prepare phases.

student_kit.name: Prepare Pack
student_kit.what: Short reading, demo video and a 10-question readiness check per module; unlocks the analyze phase at 80% or after a mentor conversation.

student_kit.name: Mentor Chat
student_kit.what: Trade mentor answers questions inside the 5-rung hint engine, starting with a nudge and only reaching a worked example after earlier rungs.
student_kit.agent: Joyce, Tessa, Gemma, Iris, Sam, Dana, Chris

student_kit.name: Skill Map
student_kit.what: Visual skill graph showing mastered, in-progress and locked skills with the next recommended mission.

student_kit.name: Practice Replay
student_kit.what: Replays a sim attempt with mentor annotations at the moments that cost points (e.g. travel speed spike, skipped LOTO step).

student_kit.name: Portfolio Builder
student_kit.what: Collects verify-phase artifacts (weld photos, formula cards, as-built reports) into a shareable portfolio clearly labeled as simulation work.

student_kit.name: Board Exam Drill (practice only)
student_kit.what: Timed practice items for state-board-style theory and EPA 608 and Part 107 topics; results are never presented as official scores.

student_kit.name: Safety Card Wallet
student_kit.what: Records completion of internal safety modules required to unlock hazardous stations; explicitly not an OSHA card.

student_kit.name: Reflection Journal
student_kit.what: Two-minute end-of-session reflection with prompts from Chris's EI course; private by default, shareable with teacher by choice.

agent_assist.role_in_course: Main assistant and course manager: runs prepare phases, schedules work, owns the EI content in TCA-410, and leads electrical, plumbing, HVAC and carpentry until dedicated mentors exist.
